(All Specs)
The GeForce RTX 6090 will be a graphics card by NVIDIA, that is expected to launch in 2027. Built on the 3 nm process, and based on the GR202 graphics processor, in its GR202-300-A1 variant, the card supports DirectX 12 Ultimate. This ensures that all modern games will run on GeForce RTX 6090. Additionally, the DirectX 12 Ultimate capability guarantees support for hardware-raytracing, variable-rate shading and more, in upcoming video games. It features 24576 shading units, 768 texture mapping units, and 192 ROPs. Also included are 768 Tensor Cores which help improve the speed of machine learning applications with support for the FP4, FP6, INT8 and FP8 data formats. The GPU also has 192 raytracing acceleration cores. NVIDIA has paired 32 GB GDDR7 memory with the GeForce RTX 6090, which is connected using a 512-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 2300 MHz, which can be boosted up to 2700 MHz, memory is running at 1750 MHz (28 Gbps effective).
Being a dual-slot card, the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 6090 draws power from 1x 16-pin power connector, with power draw rated at 525 W maximum. Display outputs include: 1x HDMI 2.1b, 3x DisplayPort 2.1b. GeForce RTX 6090 is connected to the rest of the system using a PCI-Express 5.0 x16 interface.
